## Description

Brief description of the changes.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Test improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's coding standards
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings in PSScriptAnalyzer
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally
- [ ] Code coverage threshold is met
- [ ] No hardcoded credentials, server names, or environment values
- [ ] No use of `Invoke-Expression`
- [ ] Read-only and modifying operations are clearly separated
- [ ] Public functions use `[CmdletBinding()]`
- [ ] Public functions have complete comment-based help
- [ ] Modifying functions use `SupportsShouldProcess` and `ConfirmImpact='High'`
